lede.en: AvatarTracker turns the front camera into a live puppet rig. Blink, talk, smile or tilt your head and your avatar does it with you — then tap to add a wave, a heart or a little dance on top.
lede.zh: 随影 把前置摄像头变成实时动捕台：你眨眼、说话、微笑、歪头，你的虚拟形象就同步跟着做；再点一下，还能让她挥手、比心、跳支小舞。

requirements.en: iPhone with a front camera. TrueDepth (Face ID) models track best.
requirements.zh: 带前置摄像头的 iPhone；支持面容 ID 的 TrueDepth 机型追踪效果最佳。

body.en: ARKit on TrueDepth iPhones, Apple Vision on every other one — blink, mouth, smile, brows, gaze and head pose.
body.zh: TrueDepth 机型用 ARKit，其他 iPhone 用 Apple Vision：眨眼、张嘴、微笑、眉毛、视线和头部姿态都能捕捉。

body.en: Hand-drawn characters built from separate layers: eyes that blink, lips that sync, hair that swings and arms with real joints.
body.zh: 由独立图层组成的手绘角色：会眨的眼睛、跟着说话的嘴、会甩动的头发、带关节的手臂。

body.en: Wave, heart, peace, clap, dance… presets sit on top of live tracking, so she keeps blinking and talking mid-gesture.
body.zh: 挥手、比心、剪刀手、鼓掌、跳舞……动作叠加在实时追踪之上，做动作时她照样眨眼、说话。

body.en: A quick calibration to your neutral face, then every channel is smoothed on its own: blinks stay crisp, head motion stays calm.
body.zh: 先快速校准你的自然表情，再对每个通道单独平滑：眨眼干脆利落，头部动作平稳自然。

body.en: MieMie, Mika and the classic stick figure today. Switching characters never restarts the camera.
body.zh: 目前有 MieMie、Mika 和经典火柴人；切换角色时摄像头不会重启。

body.en: Each camera frame becomes a handful of numbers in memory and is thrown away. No face images are stored or uploaded.
body.zh: 每一帧画面只在内存中变成几个数值，随即丢弃；不存储、不上传任何人脸图像。

privacy.en: Face tracking runs entirely on device
privacy.zh: 面部追踪全部在手机本地完成

privacy.en: No face images, meshes or biometric templates are kept
privacy.zh: 不保存人脸图像、网格或生物特征模板

privacy.en: No account, no ads, no third-party trackers
privacy.zh: 无需账号，无广告，无第三方追踪

title.en: Meet MieMie, our first layered character
title.zh: 认识一下 MieMie：我们的第一个分层角色

body.en: Blinking eyes, lip-sync, bouncy hair and arms that can finally wave, make a heart and throw a peace sign.
body.zh: 会眨眼、会对口型、头发会甩，手臂终于能挥手、比心、比耶了。

tagline.en: Your trip, told as a story.

headline.zh:
把照片，
变成旅行故事。

lede.en: StoryReel turns a camera roll full of travel photos into a cinematic memory video. It already knows when and where every photo was taken — so it sorts, picks and sequences for you, and animates the route between places.
lede.zh: 故事卷轴 把相册里的旅行照片变成电影感的回忆视频。它知道每张照片拍摄的时间和地点，自动帮你分章节、挑照片、排顺序，还会把地点之间的路线做成动画。

body.en: Flights and drives between chapters play out on an animated map or globe, so the story has a sense of place.
body.zh: 章节之间的飞行和自驾路线会在地图或地球上动画呈现，让故事有了地理感。

body.en: Each theme bundles a map style, color mood, route animation and typography into one pick.
body.zh: 每个主题都把地图风格、色调、路线动画和字体打包好，一键套用。

body.en: Royalty-free tracks in five moods, plus captions you type, dictate, or draft with optional AI.
body.zh: 五种氛围的免版税音乐；字幕可以手打、语音输入，或用可选的 AI 起草。

privacy.en: Photos are analysed and rendered on device
privacy.zh: 照片分析与视频渲染都在本地完成

privacy.en: No account and no backend
privacy.zh: 无账号、无后端服务器

privacy.en: AI captions are optional and off unless you add a key
privacy.zh: AI 字幕为可选功能，需自行配置后才会启用

title.zh: 故事卷轴 上线 12 款电影感主题

body.en: Globe, vintage chart, hand-drawn and more — each one a complete look for your trip video.
body.zh: 蓝色星球、复古海图、手绘……每一款都是一整套旅行视频的视觉风格。

alt.en: StoryReel Timeline tab with photos grouped by day
alt.zh: 故事卷轴时间线页：按天分组的照片

alt.en: StoryReel Home with trip projects and Browse Memories
alt.zh: 故事卷轴首页：旅行项目与回忆浏览

alt.en: StoryReel Map tab showing photo counts on a globe
alt.zh: 故事卷轴地图页：地球上标出各地照片数量

alt.en: StoryReel — Turn photos into travel stories: the Home screen with trip projects
alt.zh: 故事卷轴——把照片变成旅行故事：首页与旅行项目

body.en: Home keeps your video projects — in progress or exported — with dates, photo counts and running time. Browse Memories sorts your whole library by city or by day, so any old trip is a tap away from becoming a video.
body.zh: 首页集中管理你的视频项目——进行中的、已导出的——附带日期、照片数和时长。“浏览回忆”把整个相册按城市或按天整理好，任何一段旧旅行，点一下就能开始做成视频。

points.en: Shortcuts for a new project, by date, by map, or import
points.zh: 一键新建项目，或按日期、按地图、导入照片开始

points.en: Resume, rename, duplicate or delete any project
points.zh: 随时继续、重命名、复制或删除项目

points.en: Memories grouped by city or by day across your library
points.zh: 整个相册的回忆按城市或按天分组

points.en: No account — projects are saved on your iPhone
points.zh: 无需账号——项目保存在你的 iPhone 上

alt.en: StoryReel — Edit every chapter of the trip: the Story Builder with the Edit Chapter panel
alt.zh: 故事卷轴——编辑旅行的每个章节：故事编辑器与章节编辑面板

title.en: Edit every chapter of the trip.
title.zh: 每个章节，都能细细打磨。

body.en: Photos are grouped into chapters by place and date, with the best shots picked on device. The Story Builder lays out the whole video top to bottom — opening, route, chapters, music, captions and ending — and every part stays editable.
body.zh: 照片按地点和日期自动分成章节，并在本地挑出最好的几张。故事编辑器把整部视频从上到下铺开——开场、路线、章节、配乐、字幕、结尾——每一部分都可以修改。

points.en: Change a chapter's title, date, caption, photos and route
points.zh: 修改章节的标题、日期、字幕、照片和路线

points.en: Blinks, blurry shots and screenshots are filtered out for you
points.zh: 闭眼、模糊的照片和截图会被自动筛掉

points.en: Pick how you travelled between stops — plane, car, train and more
points.zh: 选择两站之间的交通方式——飞机、汽车、火车等

points.en: Captions typed, dictated, or drafted by optional AI
points.zh: 字幕可手打、语音输入，或用可选的 AI 起草

alt.en: StoryReel — Follow the story on Map and Timeline
alt.zh: 故事卷轴——在地图和时间线上回顾旅程

title.en: Follow the story on map and timeline.
title.zh: 在地图和时间线上，重温整段旅程。

body.en: The Map tab puts every photo on a globe, from state down to city and town; the Timeline lays your camera roll out day by day with where you went. Tap a place or select a few days to start a video from just those photos.
body.zh: 地图页把每张照片放到地球上，可以从州缩放到城市和小镇；时间线页按天铺开相册，写明你去了哪里。点一个地方、或选中几天，就能只用这些照片开始做视频。

points.en: Three zoom levels: state, city and town
points.zh: 三级缩放：州、城市、小镇

points.en: Photo counts on every place you've photographed
points.zh: 每个拍过照片的地方都标出数量

points.en: A place summary for every day
points.zh: 每一天都附地点摘要

points.en: Jump to any date from the calendar
points.zh: 用日历跳到任意日期

points.en: Start a project from a place or a few days
points.zh: 从一个地点或几天的照片开始新项目

alt.en: StoryReel — Plan, build and relive every journey: Organize, Build and Explore
alt.zh: 故事卷轴——规划、创作、重温每一段旅程：整理、创作、探索

tagline.en: Meeting memory that stays on your phone.
tagline.zh: 只存在你手机里的会议记忆。

headline.zh:
每一场会议，
都私密地记住。

lede.en: Record, transcribe and summarise a meeting without sending a word to the cloud. MeetLog turns an hour of talking into decisions, action items and open questions — in English, Chinese, or both.
lede.zh: 录音、转写、总结，一个字都不上传云端。会记 把一小时的讨论整理成决定、待办和待解决的问题——中文、英文，或中英混说都可以。

requirements.en: iOS 26 or later for on-device transcription and summaries.
requirements.zh: 本地转写与总结需要 iOS 26 或更高版本。

body.en: Start from the app, a widget or the Apple Watch Action Button, and drop markers on the moments that matter.
body.zh: 从 App、小组件或 Apple Watch 操作按钮开始录音，重要时刻随手打个标记。

body.en: Apple's on-device speech engine turns audio into a timestamped transcript that plays in sync with the recording.
body.zh: 使用 Apple 本地语音引擎生成带时间戳的文字稿，并与录音同步播放。

body.en: Decisions, action items with owners, and open questions — drafted by an on-device model, shaped by meeting type.
body.zh: 决定、带负责人的待办、未解决的问题——由本地模型生成，并按会议类型调整重点。

body.en: Built for meetings that switch between English and Chinese, with a personal dictionary for names and jargon.
body.zh: 为中英切换的会议而设计，还能用个人词典记住人名和行业术语。

body.en: Find any meeting, decision or task later, and export to Markdown when you need to share.
body.zh: 随时搜索过往的会议、决定和任务；需要分享时导出为 Markdown。

body.en: Audio, transcript and summary stay on your iPhone and paired Apple Watch. That's the first principle, not a setting.
body.zh: 录音、文字稿和总结只存在你的 iPhone 和配对的 Apple Watch 上——这是第一原则，而不是一个开关。

privacy.en: Audio, transcripts and summaries stay on device
privacy.zh: 录音、文字稿和总结都保存在本地

privacy.en: Microphone is used only while you record
privacy.zh: 只在你录音时使用麦克风

privacy.en: No account, no ads, no analytics SDKs
privacy.zh: 无需账号，无广告，无统计 SDK

title.zh: 会记 支持本地会议总结

body.en: Decisions, action items and open questions now come from a model running entirely on your iPhone.
body.zh: 决定、待办和未解决问题，现在全部由在你 iPhone 本地运行的模型生成。

tagline.en: A cosy nest for Qiao Que.
tagline.zh: 给桥鹊一个温暖的小窝。

headline.en:
A cosy nest
for Qiao Que.
headline.zh:
给桥鹊
一个温暖的小窝。

lede.en: QQNest is a light companion game built around Qiao Que (桥鹊), a voice-room host. Feed her, decorate her room, play mini-games to earn treats, and watch your bond grow — fully offline, with no account and no purchases.
lede.zh: 鹊巢是一款围绕语音厅主播「桥鹊」打造的轻量陪伴养成小游戏。投喂她、布置她的小窝、玩小游戏赚零食，看着你们的亲密度一点点升级——完全离线，无需账号，没有付费。

requirements.en: iOS 16 or later. Works fully offline.
requirements.zh: iOS 16 或更高版本，完全离线可玩。

body.en: Eight expressions and idle animations, all drawn in code — she reacts to everything you do.
body.zh: 8 种表情和待机动画，全部用代码绘制——你的每个操作她都会有反应。

body.en: Treats raise your intimacy level and unlock new stages, outfits and moments together.
body.zh: 投喂零食提升亲密度，解锁新的阶段、服装和互动时刻。

body.en: A 1024 merge puzzle and a match-3 with combos, special pieces and levels — both pay out in treats.
body.zh: 1024 合成和带连击、特殊元素、关卡的消消乐——都能赢零食奖励。

body.en: Bed, desk, window, sofa and a music corner, with decorations you unlock as you play.
body.zh: 床、书桌、窗户、沙发和音乐角，还有边玩边解锁的装饰。

body.en: Foods, outfits, decorations, expressions and achievements to collect, plus daily tasks to come back for.
body.zh: 收集食物、服装、装饰、表情和成就，每天还有新任务等你回来。

body.en: No account, no network, no in-app purchases. Your progress lives on your iPhone.
body.zh: 无账号、不联网、无内购，游戏进度只保存在你的 iPhone 上。

privacy.en: Fully offline — the game makes no network requests
privacy.zh: 完全离线，游戏不发起任何网络请求

privacy.en: Progress is stored only on your iPhone
privacy.zh: 游戏进度只保存在你的 iPhone 上

privacy.en: No account, no ads, no in-app purchases
privacy.zh: 无需账号，无广告，无内购

title.en: QQNest: a nest for Qiao Que

body.en: Feed her, decorate her room and play two mini-games — all offline.
body.zh: 投喂、布置小窝、玩两款小游戏——全程离线。

tagline.zh: 每天穿什么，替你想好了。

headline.zh:
每天穿什么，
替你想好了。

lede.en: Wearly is an AI wardrobe stylist that knows what you own, where you're going and what the weather is doing. Open it in the morning and you already know what to wear — built from clothes already in your closet.
lede.zh: 衣见是一位 AI 衣橱造型师：它知道你有哪些衣服、今天要去哪里、天气怎么样。早上打开，就知道今天穿什么——而且都来自你自己的衣柜。

requirements.en: iOS 18 or later. Live weather uses WeatherKit; calendar is optional.
requirements.zh: iOS 18 或更高版本。实时天气使用 WeatherKit，日历为可选。

body.en: Outfits planned around the whole day's forecast — a cardigan for a 61° morning that turns into a 76° afternoon.
body.zh: 按全天天气来搭配——早上 16°C、下午 24°C，就给你加一件开衫。

body.en: Reads your calendar as occasions — team meeting, dinner, gym — and dresses you for all of them at once.
body.zh: 把日历读成场合——团队会议、晚餐、健身——一套穿搭兼顾全天。

body.en: Every pick comes with a plain sentence explaining it. No scores, no jargon.
body.zh: 每套推荐都附一句大白话解释，没有分数，也没有术语。

body.en: Photograph your clothes and each piece is cut out and tagged on device — colour, pattern, fabric, warmth, formality.
body.zh: 给衣服拍张照，每件单品都会在本地自动抠图并标注颜色、图案、面料、保暖度和正式程度。

title.zh: 造型师对话与打包清单

body.en: Ask for alternatives in plain words, or get a capsule packing list: the fewest pieces for the most outfits.
body.zh: 用日常语言让它换一套，或生成胶囊打包清单：用最少的单品搭出最多的造型。

body.en: Garment photos never leave your iPhone. Calendar event titles never leave it either.
body.zh: 衣服照片不会离开你的 iPhone，日历里的事件标题也不会。

privacy.en: Clothing photos are analysed on device and never uploaded
privacy.zh: 衣物照片在本地分析，从不上传

privacy.en: Calendar events are reduced to an occasion — titles stay on device
privacy.zh: 日历事件只转换为场合类型，标题不离开设备

privacy.en: No ads, no third-party trackers
privacy.zh: 无广告，无第三方追踪

title.zh: 衣见：每天穿什么，替你想好了

body.en: An AI stylist that plans around your calendar and the forecast, using only clothes you already own.
body.zh: 一位 AI 造型师，结合日历和天气，只用你已有的衣服帮你搭配。

headline.zh:
你的资产，
只读不动。

lede.en: WorthView is a privacy-first net-worth dashboard for iPhone. Bring your bank, card and brokerage balances together with the things no bank knows about — your home, your car, your crypto — and watch one honest number over time. It can see balances. It has no way to move money.
lede.zh: 净览是一款隐私优先的 iPhone 净资产看板。把银行、信用卡和券商账户的余额，和银行不知道的资产——房子、车、加密货币——放在一起，长期看清一个真实的数字。它能看到余额，但完全没有动钱的能力。

requirements.en: iOS 17 or later. Account connections cover US banks, cards and brokerages via SimpleFIN Bridge or Plaid; manual entries work anywhere.
requirements.zh: iOS 17 或更高版本。账户连接通过 SimpleFIN Bridge 或 Plaid 覆盖美国银行、信用卡和券商；手动记录不限地区。

body.en: SimpleFIN Bridge for most US banks, cards and brokerages, a personal Plaid relay you run yourself, and Apple Wallet balances read on-device once Apple enables it. Or skip connections and add everything by hand.
body.zh: SimpleFIN Bridge 覆盖大多数美国银行、信用卡和券商；也可以用你自己部署的 Plaid 中继；Apple 钱包余额在 Apple 开放后于设备上读取。或者一个都不连，全部手动添加。

body.en: Out-of-date values are clearly labelled. If a refresh fails, your last good numbers stay on screen, marked as stale — never silently wiped.
body.zh: 过期的数值会清楚标注。刷新失败时，上一次的数据会保留在屏幕上并标为过期——绝不会悄悄清空。

body.en: Open a brokerage or retirement account to see each holding's shares, price and value, exactly as your institution reports them.
body.zh: 打开券商或退休账户，就能看到每项持仓的股数、价格和市值，与机构报告的一致。

privacy.en: Balances and holdings only — never transactions
privacy.zh: 只读取余额和持仓，从不读取交易记录

privacy.en: Bank sign-in happens at SimpleFIN or Plaid, never inside WorthView
privacy.zh: 银行登录在 SimpleFIN 或 Plaid 完成，从不经过净览

privacy.en: No 4M Studio server — entries, history and keys stay on your iPhone
privacy.zh: 4M Studio 不设服务器——记录、历史和密钥都只在你的 iPhone 上

title.zh: 净览：只读的净资产看板

body.en: Every balance you have, plus the house and the car, in one calm dashboard — with no code for moving money at all.
body.zh: 所有账户余额，再加上房子和车，集中在一个安静的看板里——而且根本没有动钱的代码。

alt.en: WorthView Assets: quick add and linked accounts grouped by type
alt.zh: 净览“资产”页：快速添加与按类型分组的已连接账户

alt.en: WorthView Overview: net worth, one-year chart, assets and liabilities
alt.zh: 净览“总览”页：净资产、一年走势、资产与负债

alt.en: WorthView Privacy: what the app cannot do, and Face ID lock
alt.zh: 净览“隐私”页：应用做不到的事与面容 ID 锁

alt.en: WorthView Overview: net worth, one-year chart, assets and liabilities
alt.zh: 净览“总览”页：净资产、一年走势、资产与负债

body.en: Net worth sits at the top with how far it has moved and a chart you can take from one month to all time. Below it, assets against liabilities in a single bar, then an allocation breakdown of where it all sits.
body.zh: 净资产放在最上方，旁边是涨跌幅，图表可以从一个月一路看到全部历史。下面一条横条对比资产与负债，再往下是资产分布。

points.en: 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y and All — the chart and change badge follow along
points.zh: 1 个月、3 个月、6 个月、1 年、全部——图表和涨跌幅一起切换

points.en: Debt shown as a share of your assets, not just a total
points.zh: 负债以占资产的比例显示，而不只是一个总数

points.en: A private daily snapshot on your iPhone builds your trend over time
points.zh: 每天在 iPhone 上保存一张私密快照，慢慢积累出你的走势

points.en: Each currency is totalled separately — no silent exchange-rate guesses
points.zh: 不同币种分开统计——不会悄悄按汇率换算

alt.en: WorthView Assets: quick add and linked accounts grouped by type
alt.zh: 净览“资产”页：快速添加与按类型分组的已连接账户

title.zh: 拥有的、欠下的，都在这里。

body.en: Linked accounts are grouped into cash, investments and retirement, each with its own total. Quick add covers what no bank reports — your home, a car, cash on hand, crypto, valuables, foreign accounts or a loan.
body.zh: 已连接的账户按现金、投资、退休账户分组，每组都有合计。“快速添加”补上银行不会告诉你的部分——房子、车、手头现金、加密货币、贵重物品、海外账户或贷款。

points.en: Every row says Linked or Manual, so you know where a number came from
points.zh: 每一行都标明“已连接”或“手动”，数字从哪来一清二楚

points.en: Manual values untouched for 90 days are flagged for a refresh
points.zh: 手动数值超过 90 天未更新，会提醒你刷新

points.en: Investment accounts open to their holdings — institution-reported, not live quotes
points.zh: 投资账户可展开查看持仓——数据来自机构，不是实时报价

points.en: Manual entries are stored only on your iPhone
points.zh: 手动记录只保存在你的 iPhone 上

alt.en: WorthView Privacy: what the app cannot do, and Face ID lock
alt.zh: 净览“隐私”页：应用做不到的事与面容 ID 锁

body.en: The Privacy tab spells out what WorthView cannot do: transfer money, trade securities, pay bills, or see your bank passwords and MFA codes. None of it is switched off — it was never built.
body.zh: “隐私”页写明了净览做不到的事：转账、买卖证券、缴费，以及查看你的银行密码和验证码。这些功能不是被关掉了，而是从来没有做过。

points.en: Optional Face ID / Touch ID, asked again after two minutes away
points.zh: 可选面容 ID / 触控 ID，离开两分钟后再次验证

points.en: Balances are hidden in the app switcher
points.zh: 在多任务界面中隐藏余额

points.en: Connection keys live in the iPhone Keychain and never sync to iCloud
points.zh: 连接密钥保存在 iPhone 钥匙串中，从不同步到 iCloud

points.en: Balances only — WorthView never downloads your transaction history
points.zh: 只读余额——净览从不下载你的交易记录

tagline.en: The right card for every purchase.

headline.zh:
刷哪张卡？
问一下就知道。

lede.en: CardPick tells you which of your credit cards earns the most on what you're about to buy. Type “Costco $200” or “Dinner $120” and get the winning card, what it earns and why — worked out on your iPhone. No card numbers, no bank logins, no accounts.
lede.zh: CardPick 告诉你，眼前这笔消费用哪张信用卡回报最高。输入“Costco $200”或“Dinner $120”，马上看到该刷哪张卡、能拿多少、为什么——全部在你的 iPhone 上算好。不需要卡号，不需要网银登录，也不用注册账号。

requirements.en: iOS 17 or later. Covers popular US credit cards.
requirements.zh: iOS 17 或更高版本。收录美国常见信用卡。

privacy.en: Only card products — never numbers, logins or account access
privacy.zh: 只记录卡片产品——从不需要卡号、登录或账户权限

privacy.en: Every recommendation is worked out on your iPhone
privacy.zh: 所有推荐都在你的 iPhone 上计算

privacy.en: No accounts, no analytics, no AI services
privacy.zh: 没有账号、没有统计分析、不调用 AI 服务

title.en: CardPick: which card should I use?

body.en: Type what you're buying and CardPick picks the card in your wallet that earns the most — right on your iPhone.
body.zh: 输入你要买什么，CardPick 就从你的钱包里挑出回报最高的那张卡——就在你的 iPhone 上。

alt.en: CardPick Benefits screen with best card by category
alt.zh: CardPick“权益”页：各类别最佳用卡

alt.en: CardPick recommending Blue Cash Preferred for Uber
alt.zh: CardPick 为 Uber 推荐 Blue Cash Preferred

alt.en: CardPick Wallet screen listing card products
alt.zh: CardPick“钱包”页：卡片产品列表

alt.en: CardPick Ask screen with quick picks by category
alt.zh: CardPick“问一问”页：按类别的快捷推荐

body.en: Start from the purchase, not the card. The Ask tab takes plain text — a store, an amount or both — and its quick picks show which card wins each everyday category before you type a thing.
body.zh: 从消费出发，而不是从卡出发。“问一问”页直接输入文字——商家、金额，或者两者都写；常用类别的最佳用卡，在你输入之前就已经列好。

points.en: “Costco $200”, “Dinner $120”, “$50 gas” — understood on your iPhone
points.zh: “Costco $200”、“Dinner $120”、“$50 gas”——在 iPhone 上直接识别

points.en: Quick picks for dining, grocery, gas, travel, streaming and more
points.zh: 餐饮、超市、加油、旅行、流媒体等快捷类别

points.en: Not sure what you meant? It offers category chips instead of guessing
points.zh: 拿不准你的意思时，会给出类别选项，而不是瞎猜

points.en: Rotating bonuses read “5% if activated” until you confirm them
points.zh: 季度轮换奖励在你确认激活前，显示为“激活后 5%”

alt.en: CardPick recommending Blue Cash Preferred for Uber
alt.zh: CardPick 为 Uber 推荐 Blue Cash Preferred

body.en: Search “Uber” and CardPick names the card to use, what it earns and why — then ranks every card in your wallet for the same purchase, so you can see how close the others come.
body.zh: 搜索“Uber”，CardPick 会告诉你该用哪张卡、能拿多少、为什么——再把钱包里每张卡按这笔消费排名，其他卡差多少一目了然。

points.en: The winning card and its rate, front and centre
points.zh: 最佳用卡和回报率，放在最显眼的位置

points.en: The reason in plain words — “Transit: taxis, rideshare, parking… earns 3%”
points.zh: 用大白话说明原因——“交通出行：出租车、网约车、停车……返 3%”

points.en: Points and miles stay points unless you set your own value
points.zh: 积分和里程默认按积分显示，除非你自己设定价值

points.en: Offers you've added stack on top of the card's usual earning
points.zh: 你添加的优惠会叠加在这张卡的常规回报之上

alt.en: CardPick Benefits screen with best card by category
alt.zh: CardPick“权益”页：各类别最佳用卡

title.en: All your benefits, at a glance.

body.en: The Benefits tab turns fine print into a dashboard: how many cards you carry, how many bonus categories they cover, and when this quarter's 5% runs out.
body.zh: “权益”页把条款细则变成一张看板：你有几张卡、覆盖多少奖励类别，以及本季度的 5% 什么时候结束。

points.en: Best card for every category, with the “if activated” upside beside it
points.zh: 每个类别的最佳用卡，并列显示“激活后”的额外回报

points.en: Your cards in a swipeable carousel with their headline rates
points.zh: 卡片轮播，滑动查看每张卡的主要回报

points.en: A badge counts bonuses still waiting for activation
points.zh: 角标提示还有几项奖励等待激活

points.en: Spending caps are shown — never guessed
points.zh: 消费上限如实标出，绝不猜测

alt.en: CardPick Wallet screen listing card products
alt.zh: CardPick“钱包”页：卡片产品列表

title.zh: 只记卡片产品，不碰卡号。

body.en: Add the cards you carry by product name. CardPick never asks for numbers, logins or account access, and everything it keeps stays on your iPhone.
body.zh: 按产品名称添加你持有的卡。CardPick 从不索取卡号、登录或账户权限，保存的一切都只在你的 iPhone 上。

points.en: Popular US cards from Chase, Amex, Discover, Capital One, Citi and Wells Fargo
points.zh: 收录 Chase、Amex、Discover、Capital One、Citi、Wells Fargo 的美国常见信用卡

points.en: Add offers from your card's app — like 10% back at Nike
points.zh: 添加发卡行 App 里的优惠——比如 Nike 返 10%

points.en: Refresh reads the issuer's public bonus calendar, only when you tap
points.zh: 刷新只读取发卡行公开的奖励日历，而且只在你点击时

points.en: No accounts, no analytics, no AI services
points.zh: 没有账号、没有统计分析、不调用 AI 服务
